description: Synthetic sesslint.reference parity (early gates and documented dump seam).
known_parity_gaps: GAP-reference-dump-canonical: reference_equivalent and reference_equivalent_if_clean on non-empty inputs at or below MAX_REFERENCE_EVENTS call sesslint.adapters.canonical.dump_canonical. Rust returns DumpCanonicalUnavailable and does not call dump_canonical or load_canonical. The harness asserts that seam and does not treat pin success as equal to the seam.
